name: Jicama
siboNotes: Well-tolerated on SIBO diet due to low fermentable carbohydrate content. Provides beneficial fiber without triggering bacterial overgrowth.
preparationTips: Peel thick skin completely before eating - only the white flesh is edible
Can be eaten raw for maximum crunch or lightly cooked
Store whole jicama at room temperature, cut pieces in refrigerator
Add lemon juice to prevent browning when cut
